name: instagram-agent
description: Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet that exports edit timings, a video checker that measures the rendered reel (motion, cuts, safe zone, caption sync, loop, loudness), viral research ranked by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits from your own API metrics with a hook scorer calibrated to your reels, optional gated publishing through the official API, and a humanizer.
